name: Crimson desires
source:
A young lady wants to become a vampire; this is her lifelong dream, and she is so close she can almost taste it. The only living vampire that accepts transforming mortals is an eccentric woman with extremely powerful magic. She is the judge and executioner of those she does not consider worthy of immortality. 

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/crimson-desires]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位年轻女士想成为吸血鬼；这是她毕生的梦想，她近在咫尺，几乎可以尝到它的滋味。唯一接受变形凡人的活吸血鬼是一位古怪的女人，她拥有极其强大的魔法。她是那些她认为不值得永生的人的法官和刽子手。

[来自[url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/crimson-desires]itch.io[/url]]
